name: Email Phishing
short: Mass emails jo asli companies jaisi lagti hain.
definition: Mass emails jo kisi trusted brand (bank, PayPal, Amazon, Instagram) jaise dikhte hain. Ek hi email hazaaron logon ko bhejte hain — jaise machhli pakadne ke liye jaal daalte hain.
how_it_works: Hacker asli email template copy karta hai (logo, footer, colors)
Sender address thoda modify karta hai (support@amaz0n.com)
Urgency create karta hai: '24 ghante me account band!'
Link daalta hai jo nakli login page pe le jaata hai
Credentials aate hi hacker login karta hai

examples.title: Amazon impersonation
examples.subject: Urgent: Aapka account suspend ho jayega
examples.body:
Dear Customer,

Humne aapke account me suspicious activity detect ki hai.
Aapki account 24 ghante me permanently suspend kar di jayegi.

Verify karne ke liye neeche click karo:
[ Verify Account Now ] (http://amaz0n-verify.tk/login)

Agar aap ise ignore karte hain, aapka data delete ho jayega.

Amazon Security Team
red_flags: Sender: amaz0n-verify.tk (asli nahi — 0 ki jagah O)

examples.title: Netflix payment update
examples.subject: Aapka payment fail ho gaya — account band hone wala hai
examples.body:
Hi Member,

Aapke card se payment fail ho gaya (insufficient funds).
Aapka Netflix account 48 ghante me band ho jayega.

Payment update karne ke liye:
[ Update Payment ] (http://netflix-billing.tk/update)

Aapki favourite shows delete ho jayengi.

- Netflix Billing Team

examples.title: Google storage full
examples.subject: Aapki Google Drive full ho gayi hai
examples.body:
Hello,

Aapka Google storage 99% full hai.
Naya content save karne ke liye storage upgrade karo.

[ Upgrade for free ] (http://google-storage.tk/upgrade)

Free me 100GB mil raha hai — sirf aaj!

- Google Team
red_flags: 'Free me 100GB' — Google kabhi free nahi deta
Links jo asli domain pe nahi jaate
prevention: Sender email address dhyaan se dekho
Link pe hover karo — asli URL dekho
Company app ya website manually type karke kholo
Kisi bhi email se login mat karo
real_case: 2016 — Google + Facebook ne $100 million BEC scam me khoye. Hacker ne ek vendor company ka email spoof kiya aur fake invoices bhejein.

name: Spear Phishing
short: Kisi specific person ko target karke personalized attack.
definition: Email Phishing ka targeted version. Hacker pehle victim ke baare me research karta hai (LinkedIn, Facebook, company website) — phir personalized email bhejta hai. Bahut zyada believable hota hai.
how_it_works: OSINT — victim ke baare me sab collect
LinkedIn se job title, colleagues, projects
Social media se interests, family, friends

examples.title: Fake HR annual review
examples.subject: Rahul — Annual Review Form (Deadline today)
examples.body:
Hi Rahul,

HR ne kaha aapko ye form aaj shaam tak bharna hai.
Ye aapke performance review ke liye zaroori hai.

[ Open Review Form ] (http://company-hr-portal.tk/review)

Aapke manager (Amit) ne kaha aapka review urgent hai.

Best,
Priya

examples.title: Conference invitation
examples.subject: Speaker invitation: Your paper on IoT security
examples.body:
Dear Dr. Kumar,

I read your paper on IoT vulnerabilities (from IEEE 2025).
Excellent work! We'd love to have you as a keynote speaker.

Please confirm your participation and submit your slides here:
[ Speaker Portal ] (http://cybersec-conf-portal.tk/speaker)

The conference is in 3 weeks, so we need your response urgently.

Best regards,
Sarah

examples.title: Job offer follow-up
examples.subject: Rahul — Final round interview confirmation
examples.body:
Hi Rahul,

Congratulations on clearing the first two rounds!
Our hiring manager (Vikram) was very impressed.

Final round is scheduled for tomorrow at 3 PM.
Please complete this pre-interview form:

[ Complete Form ] (http://amazon-careers-portal.tk/form)

Include your:
- PAN card number
- Aadhaar (for background check)
- Previous company payslip

- Amazon Talent Team

prevention: Colleague ko directly call/message karke confirm karo
LinkedIn pe apni info kam rakho
real_case: 2020 — Twitter hack. 130+ high-profile accounts target hui. Hacker ne Twitter employees ko spear-phish kiya.

name: Whaling
short: CEO/CFO jaisi badi machhli ko target karna.
definition: Spear Phishing ka elite version — CEO, CFO, Founder, Board Members jaise senior executives ko target karta hai. Bade paise ke liye.
how_it_works: Jab wo busy ho (conference, flight) tab attack
Legal notice, court order, ya urgent wire transfer
Bahut polished — koi grammar mistake nahi

examples.title: Fake legal notice
examples.subject: CONFIDENTIAL: Acquisition Documents
examples.body:
Dear Sir,

Attached is the confidential NDA for the pending acquisition.
Please review and sign before market open tomorrow.

Due to confidentiality, do NOT discuss with anyone else.

Documents: [ Secure Download ] (https://firm-secure-docs.tk/acq)

Regards,
Legal Counsel

examples.title: CEO urgent wire request
examples.subject: Re: Vendor Payment (Urgent)
examples.body:
Rahul,

I'm in a board meeting, can't talk.
Process this vendor payment immediately — bank change hui hai:

Bank: HDFC
A/c: 9876543210
IFSC: HDFC0001234
Amount: Rs.75,00,000

Confirm when done. Keep confidential (M&A reasons).

- CEO

examples.title: Tax authority notice
examples.subject: FINAL NOTICE: Tax Evasion Detected
examples.body:
Dear Taxpayer,

Our system has detected discrepancies in your ITR.
Outstanding amount: Rs.12,45,000 + penalty Rs.2,00,000

Pay immediately to avoid:
- Bank account freeze
- Passport cancellation
- Legal proceedings

Pay now: [ Pay Tax ] (http://incometax-gov-in.tk/pay)

- Income Tax Department

prevention: Wire transfers ke liye verbal confirmation
Legal/financial requests ko second channel se verify
real_case: 2019 — Cab company. Hacker ne CEO ka email spoof kiya aur UK branch se EUR 200,000 wire transfer karwa liya.

name: Smishing (SMS Phishing)
short: SMS/text message ke through phishing.
definition: SMS + Phishing = Smishing. Fake SMS bhejte hain — bank alert, parcel delivery, lottery, govt notification jaise. Mobile pe links usually shortened hote hain, isliye URL verify karna mushkil.
how_it_works: Bulk SMS gateway use karke lakhon messages
Bank alert, parcel, KYC, lottery — koi bhi story
Victim link kholta hai aur credentials daalta hai

examples.title: Fake SBI KYC
examples.subject: SMS message
examples.body:
Dear SBI Customer, aapka KYC aaj expire ho raha hai.
Turant update karo warna account block:
http://sbi-kyc-update.bit.ly/verify

- SBI Bank

examples.title: Parcel delivery scam
examples.subject: SMS message
examples.body:
DTDC: Your parcel (AWB#7845XXXX) is on hold due to
incomplete address. Update within 24 hours to avoid return:
http://dtdc-parcel-update.tk/address

Pay Rs.25 re-delivery charge.

- DTDC Team

examples.title: Lottery win
examples.subject: SMS message
examples.body:
Congratulations! Aapne KBC Lottery 2026 me
Rs.25,00,000 jeeta hai!

Claim karne ke liye WhatsApp karo: +91-98XXXXXX
Ya link kholo: http://kbc-lottery-claim.tk/win

Sirf 48 hours me claim karo!

- KBC Team

prevention: Shortened URL pe click mat karo
Suspicious SMS ko 7726 pe report karo
real_case: 2023 — India me SBI KYC smishing wave. Lakhon logon ko fake SMS gaye, hazaaron accounts compromise hue.

name: Vishing (Voice Phishing)
short: Phone call pe dhokha dena.
definition: Voice + Phishing = Vishing. Hacker phone call karta hai, khud ko bank/company/govt official batata hai. IVR (press 1) ya human caller ke through sensitive info maangta hai.
how_it_works: Caller ID spoofing — number asli lagta hai
Background me call center jaisi awaaz
Urgent story: 'Aapke account se fraud ho raha hai'
Remote access tool install karwa deta hai

examples.title: Fake bank fraud alert
examples.subject: Phone call
examples.body:
[Phone rings]

Caller: Main SBI card department se bol raha hoon.
Aapke card pe suspicious transaction aaya hai — Rs.45,000.

Verify karne ke liye aapko ek OTP aayega, wo bata dijiye.
Agar nahi batate, hum card block kar denge.

[Victim OTP bata deta hai]
Caller: Thank you sir, card safe hai. Goodbye.

[5 minute baad — Rs.45,000 withdrawn]
red_flags: Bank se bol raha hai par OTP maang raha hai

examples.title: Tech support (Microsoft)
examples.subject: Phone call
examples.body:
Caller: Hello, I'm from Microsoft Windows Support.
Aapke computer me virus detect hua hai.

Aapka computer 2 ghante me hack ho jayega.
Fix karne ke liye AnyDesk install karo.

[Victim AnyDesk install karta hai]
[Hacker screen dekhta hai, bank credentials capture karta hai]

examples.title: Fake police / CBI call
examples.subject: Phone call
examples.body:
Caller: Main CBI officer bol raha hoon.
Aapke naam pe ek parcel mila hai jisme drugs mile hain.

Arrest warrant ready hai. Bhai ko bachana hai?
Security deposit ke liye Rs.50,000 transfer karo.

[Victim panic me transfer kar deta hai]

prevention: OTP kabhi kisi ko mat batao
Bank ko official number pe callback karo
Remote access apps mat install karo
real_case: 2022 — India vishing scam. 'Amazon refund' calls se hazaaron logon ne Rs.100 crore+ khoye.

name: Clone Phishing
short: Asli email ko copy karke modify kar dena.
definition: Hacker ek asli email (jo aapko pehle mila tha) ko copy karta hai. Content, sender, sab kuch same — bas link ya attachment replace kar deta hai. 'Resent' ya 'Updated version' bol ke bhejta hai.
how_it_works: Sab kuch copy — sender, subject, formatting

examples.title: Updated Q4 report
examples.subject: RE: Q4 Report (Updated)
examples.body:
Rahul,

Ye updated Q4 report hai. Purani wali me error thi.

[Q4_Report_v2.xlsx] - malicious macro

Please review before tomorrow's board meeting.

- Boss

examples.title: Invoice follow-up
examples.subject: RE: Invoice #INV-2024-0892 (Revised)
examples.body:
Hello,

Revised invoice attach kar raha hoon. GST number update hui thi.

[INV-2024-0892-REVISED.pdf.exe]

Kindly process by EOD.

- Accounts Team

examples.title: Calendar invite update
examples.subject: Updated invitation: Board Meeting
examples.body:
Board Meeting moved to 10:00 AM.

Updated details: [ Join Meeting ] (http://company-zoom-meet.tk/join)

Meeting ID: 845-XXX-XXXX
Password: board2026

- Organizer

prevention: Attachment pe double-click se pehle extension dekho
Sender ko second channel pe confirm karo
Suspicious attachments ko sandbox me open karo
Email client me full header dekho
real_case: Clone phishing common hai corporate environments me — attacker pehle ek account compromise karta hai, phir us account se sab contacts ko clone emails bhejta hai.

name: HTTPS Phishing
short: Fake sites jo HTTPS use karti hain (lock icon).
definition: Log sochte hain 'https + lock = safe'. Ye galat hai! Hackers free SSL certificates le sakte hain (Let's Encrypt). Toh unki nakli site bhi HTTPS dikhati hai.
how_it_works: Hacker Let's Encrypt se free SSL certificate leta hai
Nakli site HTTPS pe host karta hai
Victim sochta hai 'safe hai' aur credentials daalta hai

examples.title: PayPal secure login fake
examples.subject: Address bar
examples.body:
https://secure-paypal-login.xyz/signin

'Lock icon hai, HTTPS hai — safe hai!' soch ke login karte ho.

GALAT!
- Certificate 30 second me free mila
- Domain .xyz sasta
- 'secure-paypal-login' = brand subdomain trick
- Ye PayPal ki NAHI hai
red_flags: Brand URL me hai par asli domain nahi

examples.title: Bank with valid SSL cert
examples.subject: Address bar
examples.body:
https://hdfc-secure-banking.tk/login

Lock icon OK
Valid SSL certificate OK

Par ye HDFC ki asli site nahi hai. Certificate khud hacker ne generate kiya.

examples.title: Government site fake
examples.subject: Address bar
examples.body:
https://incometax-gov-in.co.in/login

'co.in' asli lagta hai? Par asli incometax.gov.in hai, ye incometax-gov-in.co.in hai.

Lock icon aur HTTPS sab theek, par domain trick hai.

prevention: Lock icon dekho mat — DOMAIN dekho
Asli sites ka domain yaad rakho
real_case: 2017 ke baad har phishing site HTTPS use karti hai. Let's Encrypt ne free certs diye — hackers ne turant use kiya.

name: Popup Phishing
short: Fake virus alert popup.
definition: Browser me achanak popup aata hai: 'Aapke computer me virus hai! Turant call karo Microsoft ko!' — aur ek toll-free number deta hai.
how_it_works: Malicious ad network se popup inject
Call karne pe technician remote access maangta hai

examples.title: Windows Defender fake
examples.subject: System Warning
examples.body:
WINDOWS DEFENDER ALERT

Aapke computer me 5 viruses detected!
Banking credentials compromised!
System 5 minute me lock ho jayega!

Call Microsoft Support: 1-800-XXX-XXXX

[Close button kaam nahi karta]
red_flags: Microsoft kabhi popup se alert nahi bhejta

examples.title: Fake Flash update
examples.subject: Adobe Flash Required
examples.body:
Adobe Flash Player out of date!

Aapka browser insecure hai.
Video play nahi hoga.

[Update Now] - download .exe

[Later] - bhi download karta hai

examples.title: Fake gift card winner
examples.subject: Congratulations!
examples.body:
You won a $1000 Amazon Gift Card!

Answer 3 questions to claim.

[Claim Now]

(Actually — credit card info maangta hai 'shipping' ke liye)

real_case: Tech support scams — $1.5 billion/year industry. Mostly targeting elderly users in US, UK, India.

name: Angler Phishing
short: Social media pe fake customer support.
definition: Social media pe aap company ko complaint karte ho. Hacker ek fake 'support' account banata hai jo turant reply karta hai — 'DM me aao, hum help karte hain.' DM me credentials maangta hai.
how_it_works: Victim company ke handle ko tweet karta hai
Turant reply: 'Sorry for trouble. Please DM us.'
DM me: 'Verify karne ke liye login karo'

examples.title: Airline fake support
examples.subject: Twitter reply
examples.body:
[Victim tweets]
@AirlineXYZ flight cancelled, refund chahiye!

[Fake account replies]
@Airline_Support_Help:
Sorry! Please DM us booking ID, we'll process immediately.

[DM me]
Login here to verify: http://airline-refund.tk/login

[Credentials to hacker]

examples.title: Bank fake Twitter support
examples.subject: Twitter reply

examples.title: Instagram fake copyright
examples.subject: Instagram DM
examples.body:
Copyright Strike

Your account has been reported for copyright infringement.
If not resolved in 24 hours, your account will be permanently deleted.

Appeal here: http://instagram-appeal.tk/verify

- Instagram Copyright Team
red_flags: Instagram kabhi DM me copyright nahi bhejta

prevention: Kabhi DM me credentials mat do
Company website pe hi complaint karo
real_case: 2019 — Multiple airlines ke fake handles. Twitter ne ek crackdown kiya jab hazaaron log affected hue.

name: Business Email Compromise (BEC)
short: Company ke email se fraud karwana.
definition: Hacker company ka email account compromise karta hai (ya spoof karta hai), phir fake invoices bhejta hai, wire transfer request karta hai, ya employee data maangta hai.
how_it_works: Ya spoof — sender name asli jaisa

examples.title: Vendor bank change
examples.subject: Re: Vendor Payment (Urgent)
examples.body:
Rahul,

I'm in a meeting, can't talk. Process this vendor payment
immediately. Bank details change hui hain:

Bank: XYZ Bank
Account: 1234567890
IFSC: XYZ0001234
Amount: Rs.45,00,000

Confidential (M&A reasons).

- CEO

examples.title: Fake purchase order
examples.subject: PO #PO-2026-4512 — Urgent Fulfillment
examples.body:
Dear Supplier,

Please fulfill this urgent order. Payment will be processed
on net-30 terms as usual.

PO attached: [PO-2026-4512.pdf]

Shipping to new address (mentioned in PO).

Confirm on priority.

- Procurement Team

examples.title: W-2 / employee data request
examples.subject: Confidential: All Employee W-2 Records
examples.body:
Hi,

For the annual tax filing, I need a consolidated W-2 file of all
employees. Please send as password-protected ZIP.

Required by tomorrow EOD (auditor deadline).

- HR Director

prevention: Wire transfers ke liye phone confirmation
Vendor bank changes ke liye dual approval
real_case: FBI ke hisaab se BEC se $50+ billion loss (2013-2023). Google + Facebook ne 2016 me $100M khoya.

name: Pharming
short: DNS hack karke asli URL pe nakli site.
definition: Hacker DNS server ya aapke computer ka hosts file modify karta hai. Ab jab aap 'paypal.com' type karo — nakli site khulti hai. URL bilkul sahi dikhta hai, par site nakli hai!
how_it_works: DNS server hack, ya router malware, ya hosts file modify
DNS entry badal do: paypal.com to hacker_ka_ip
Nakli site khulti hai — URL sahi

examples.title: Hosts file modification
examples.subject: Silent redirect
examples.body:
Aap type karte ho: www.paypal.com

[Behind the scenes]
DNS lookup - hosts file modify
paypal.com - 185.xxx.xxx.xxx (hacker)

[Browser]
https://www.paypal.com/signin - URL sahi dikhta hai!
[Par ye asli PayPal nahi]

Aap login karte ho - hacker ke paas

examples.title: Router DNS hijack
examples.subject: All devices affected
examples.body:
Hacker aapke router ka admin password guess kar leta hai (default: admin/admin).
Router DNS setting badal deta hai — saare devices affected.

Ab har device 'google.com' type kare - hacker site khulti hai.

Weeks tak pata nahi chalta.

examples.title: Public DNS poisoning
examples.subject: ISP-level
examples.body:
Kabhi-kabhi ISP level pe DNS poisoning hoti hai — govt ya attacker.

Example: pura region ka 'twitter.com' - fake site pe jaata hai.
Victim ko kuch pata nahi chalta.

prevention: Router ka admin password change karo
HTTPS certificate warning ko ignore mat karo
real_case: 2007 — Mexican bank Banca de los Andes. DNS hack se $100k+ loss.

name: Evil Twin (WiFi Phishing)
short: Fake WiFi hotspot jo asli jaisa dikhta hai.
definition: Hacker ek fake WiFi hotspot banata hai jo asli (jaise 'Starbucks WiFi') jaisa dikhta hai. Aap connect karte ho - saara traffic hacker ke through.
how_it_works: Hacker ek WiFi router setup karta hai (open)

examples.title: Airport fake WiFi
examples.subject: Open network
examples.body:
Aap airport pe ho. WiFi list:

- Airport_Free_WiFi (asli)
- Airport_Free_WiFi_2 (hacker)
- Airport_Official (asli)

Aap strong signal dekh ke fake wale pe connect karte ho.
Login page khulta hai: 'Email + password for WiFi access'

Aap daalte ho - hacker ke paas

examples.title: Hotel lobby fake portal
examples.subject: Captive portal
examples.body:
Hotel me WiFi connect karte ho.
Captive portal khulta hai: 'Room number + last name'

Aap daalte ho - portal 'Card details for verification' maangta hai.

Ye hotel ka asli portal nahi hai.

examples.title: Conference coffee shop
examples.subject: Fake hotspot
examples.body:
Conference ke aas paas hacker ek hotspot chalata hai:
'Conference_2026_Guest'

Attendees connect karte hain.
Slack/email credentials capture ho jaate hain.

prevention: Staff se official WiFi naam poochho
Public WiFi pe VPN on karo
Sensitive kaam public WiFi pe mat karo
real_case: 2014 — World Cup Brazil. Hacker ne fake WiFi setup kiya, hazaaron tourists ke credentials chori kiye.

name: Watering Hole
short: Common website ko infect karo, phir wait karo.
definition: Sher jungle me paani ke hole pe aata hai, wahan shikaar karta hai. Waise hi — hacker ek website jo specific group visit karta hai usko infect karta hai.

examples.title: Defense news site
examples.subject: Drive-by
examples.body:
Defense industry news website (legitimate) compromise.

Visitor - page load - hidden iframe - exploit
- unpatched browser vulnerability trigger
- malware install - attacker full access

Victim ko kuch pata nahi.

examples.title: Human rights forum
examples.subject: Drive-by
examples.body:
Human rights activists ka ek forum compromise.

Vo specific political group target — attackers ne forum infect kiya.
Ek PDF 'report' me exploit tha.

Visitors ne download kiya - RAT install.

examples.title: Crypto news site
examples.subject: Drive-by
examples.body:
Crypto news site compromise.

Visitors ko clipboard hijacker mila —
jab wo wallet address copy karte, hacker ka address paste hota.

$1M+ chori.

real_case: 2017 — Forbes.com watering hole. Attackers ne US financial industry ke visitors ko target kiya.

name: Tabnabbing
short: Inactive tab achanak login page ban jaaye.
definition: Aap ek tab kholte ho (jaise Google). Fir dusre tab me kaam karte ho. Pehla tab inactive ho jaata hai. Hacker ka script wait karta hai — jab aap wapas aate ho, tab achanak nakli login page dikhata hai.
how_it_works: Tab inactive ho - favicon + title + content replace

examples.title: Gmail session expired
examples.subject: Tab switching
examples.body:
Aap link click karte ho (malicious site). Fir dusre tab me jaate ho.

5 min baad wapas:
- Favicon: Gmail jaisa
- Title: Sign in - Google
- Content: Session expired. Please sign in again.

Aap login karte ho - hacker ke paas

examples.title: Facebook re-login
examples.subject: Tab switching
examples.body:
Facebook tab khula tha. Aap YouTube dekhte ho.
Wapas aate ho - Facebook ka 'session expired' page.

URL Facebook ka dikhta hai, par actually hacker page hai.

examples.title: Company SSO
examples.subject: Tab switching
examples.body:
Company SSO page khula tha.
Aap lunch ke liye gaye.
Wapas aaye - 'Session expired, please re-authenticate'.

Username + password daala - hacker capture kar leta hai.

prevention: Tab inactive ho to close karo
real_case: 2010 — Aza Raskin ne ye attack demonstrate kiya. Firefox ne patched kiya.

name: Pretexting
short: Ek fake story bana ke info nikalna.
definition: Pretext = ek nakli kahani. Hacker khud ko koi aur batata hai (IT support, police, insurance agent) aur ek believable kahani sunata hai.
how_it_works: Victim ke baare me basic info collect

examples.title: Fake IT audit
examples.subject: Annual Security Audit
examples.body:
Hello,

Company ke IT department se hoon. Annual security audit.
Aapko chhota test dena hai:

1. Username: ______
2. Password: ______
3. Employee ID: ______

ISO 27001 compliance ke liye zaroori. Aaj shaam tak bhej dijiye.

- IT Audit Team

examples.title: Insurance claim follow-up
examples.subject: Claim Approval - Bank Details Required
examples.body:
Dear Policy Holder,

Aapka claim Rs.5,50,000 approve hua hai.
Payment ke liye bank details bhejein:

- A/c number
- IFSC
- Net banking password (verification)

Return within 48 hours.

- LIC Claims

examples.title: Police verification call
examples.subject: Phone call
examples.body:
Caller: Main Inspector Sharma bol raha hoon.
Aapke area me chain snatching hui hai.
Aapka naam suspect list me hai.

Clear karne ke liye Aadhaar number + address confirm karo.
Agar nahi, to FIR darj karenge.

[Victim panic me details de deta hai]
red_flags: Police phone pe verification nahi karti

prevention: IT department ko direct call karo
Sensitive info ke liye in-person verification
real_case: 2015 — Ubiquiti Networks. Pretexting se $46.7M loss.

name: AI-Generated Phishing
short: ChatGPT jaise LLMs se perfect emails banao.
definition: Hackers ab ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini jaise AI tools use karke perfect grammar, personalized, aur context-aware phishing emails banate hain. Purane phishing me spelling mistakes hoti thi — ab wo 'tell' nahi hai.
how_it_works: AI se corporate email template generate karo
OSINT data feed karo (LinkedIn, past emails)

examples.title: Perfect grammar CEO email
examples.subject: Quick sync on Q4 roadmap
examples.body:
Hi Rahul,

Hope you're having a good week. I wanted to follow up on our discussion
last Thursday regarding the Q4 roadmap. Priya mentioned you'd have the
draft ready by now.

Could you share the updated deck? I'd like to review before the board
call on Friday.

Also — quick ask. The vendor payment we discussed needs to go out today.
I've updated the bank details in the attached sheet.

Thanks for staying on top of this.

Best,
Vikram

examples.title: AI-personalized LinkedIn message
examples.subject: Opportunity at a stealth startup
examples.body:
Hi Rahul,

I came across your profile and your work on distributed systems
at [Company]. Impressive. Your blog post on consensus algorithms
was one of the clearest explanations I've read.

We're building a stealth fintech — Series B, backed by Sequoia.
We're looking for a Staff Engineer. Comp: Rs.1.2-1.8 Cr + equity.

Interested? Quick intro call this week?

Best,
Ananya

examples.title: AI voice note (in email)
examples.subject: Beta, please help
examples.body:
Beta,

Mera phone kharab ho gaya. Naya number hai — +91-98XXXXX.
Emergency me paise chahiye — UPI kar do 20,000.

Ye voice note sun lo: [voice.mp3]

Jaldi karo please.

- Mummy
red_flags: Gmail me family nahi hota aise

prevention: Sender ko second channel pe verify karo (call)
Unusual requests ko slow down karo
AI voice clone ke liye family password
real_case: 2024 — Hong Kong firm me employee ne AI-cloned CFO ki video call dekhi aur $25 million transfer kar diya. Ye pehla documented AI-deepfake heist tha.

name: Deepfake Phishing
short: AI video/audio clone — asli insaan jaisa.
definition: AI se kisi ka face ya awaaz clone karke video call ya voice message. Aapko lagta hai CEO/mom/friend bol raha hai — actually AI hai. Ye sabse khatarnak modern phishing hai.
how_it_works: Target ke 5-10 min ka video/audio collect
Real-time video call ke liye deepfake
Emergency create karo, paise ya info maango

examples.title: AI CFO video call heist
examples.subject: Urgent wire authorization
examples.body:
Aapka CFO Zoom call pe aata hai (visually identical).
Background me 'board meeting' ka setup.

CFO: Rahul, urgent wire transfer karna hai. Confidential deal.
Amount: $25M. I'll share details in chat.

Aap transfer karte ho. 15 minute baad CFO ka real phone aata hai —
Main kahan tha? Meeting me nahi tha.

Ye 2024 ka Hong Kong case hai.

examples.title: Mom's voice WhatsApp call
examples.subject: Family emergency
examples.body:
Aapko WhatsApp call aata hai — 'Mom'.
Awaaz bilkul mom jaisi.

Mom: Beta, accident ho gaya papa ka. Hospital me hain.
20,000 UPI kar do turant.

Aap kar dete ho. Baad me pata chalta — mom ka phone tha hi nahi.
AI voice clone (Instagram story se 30 sec audio kaafi).

examples.title: Fake CEO video message
examples.subject: Important message from CEO
examples.body:
Email me video attach: CEO's quarterly message.

Video me CEO bolte hain: Team, I need everyone to update
their credentials on this new portal: company-sso-2026.tk

Video real lagti hai (deepfake).
Employees update karte hain - credentials compromise.
red_flags: CEO video me URL bolte hain

prevention: Video call me challenge question poochho
real_case: 2024 — Arup (Hong Kong). Employee ne deepfake CFO video dekha aur $25M transfer kiye.

name: QR Code Phishing (Quishing)
short: Malicious QR code se phishing site.
definition: Hackers QR codes use karte hain kyunki URL visible nahi hoti. Restaurant menu, parking ticket, poster — koi bhi QR code malicious ho sakta hai. Scan karo - malicious site khulti hai.
how_it_works: Asli QR code ke upar paste karo

examples.title: Restaurant menu QR
examples.subject: Table tent QR code
examples.body:
Restaurant me QR code table pe: Menu dekho.

Scan karo - fake site khulti hai:
WiFi password ke liye email login karo ya
Menu ke liye Rs.1 pay karo (card verify).

Asli QR ke upar hacker ne apna sticker laga diya tha.
red_flags: QR scan ke baad payment/credentials maange

examples.title: Fake parking ticket
examples.subject: Scan to pay
examples.body:
Parking meter pe QR: Scan to pay Rs.50.

Aap scan karo - fake payment page:
Card number, CVV, OTP daalo.

Card details chori.

Asli meter ka QR hacker ne replace kiya tha.

examples.title: Malicious wedding invitation
examples.subject: QR for venue
examples.body:
Wedding invitation me QR: Venue location

Scan - Google Maps nahi, ek .tk site khulti hai:
Wedding album dekhne ke liye Google login karo.

Credentials chori.

Physical card me QR malicious tha.

prevention: QR scan se pehle URL preview dekho
Restaurant se confirm karo menu QR
real_case: 2023 — Multiple US cities me parking meter QR scam. Cyber criminals ne QR stickers laga diye real meters pe.

name: OAuth / Consent Phishing
short: Fake app ko permission de do — password nahi chahiye.
definition: Hacker ek fake app banata hai (jaise 'PDF Viewer'). Aapko lagta hai asli app hai, aap 'Allow' karte ho. Bas! Hacker ko aapke Gmail/Drive/Calendar ka full access mil gaya — bina password ke.
how_it_works: Hacker OAuth app register karta hai
Victim ko email link milta hai

examples.title: Fake Microsoft app consent
examples.subject: New app permission required
examples.body:
Aapko email: A new app wants to access your Microsoft account.

App: Advanced Email Manager
Permissions requested:
  - Read your email
  - Send email as you
  - Access your files
  - Read your contacts

[ Allow ] [ Deny ]

Aap 'Allow' karte ho - hacker ko full mailbox access.

examples.title: Fake Google Drive viewer
examples.subject: Document shared with you
examples.body:
Aapko link: Shared Document

Click - Google login maangta hai.
Phir: App 'Drive PDF Viewer' wants access to your Google account

[Allow]

Hacker ko:
- Gmail read
- Drive read/write
- Contacts access

App 'PDF Viewer' bas ek cover tha.
red_flags: App 'PDF Viewer' ko Gmail access kyun?

examples.title: Slack app install scam
examples.subject: New integration available
examples.body:
Team Slack me link: Add 'Standup Bot' integration

Click - Slack OAuth consent:
'Standup Bot' wants to:
  - Read all your messages
  - Post as you
  - Access files

[Allow]

Hacker ko Slack ka full access.

prevention: OAuth consent screen dhyaan se padho
real_case: 2023 — Multiple BEC campaigns OAuth consent se. Hacker ne 'Adobe' jaisa fake app banaya, employees ne 'Allow' kiya.

name: Supply Chain Phishing
short: Trusted software update me malware.
definition: Hacker ek trusted software company compromise karta hai. Fir us company ke updates me malware daal deta hai. Aap update karte ho aur malware install ho jaata hai — bina kisi phishing email ke.
how_it_works: Millions of users update karte hain

examples.title: SolarWinds-style attack
examples.subject: Automatic update
examples.body:
SolarWinds Orion software (used by US govt + Fortune 500)
me backdoor inject hua.

Sab users automatic update karte — malware install.

18,000+ organizations affected (including US Treasury, DHS).

2020 ka sabse bada supply chain attack.

examples.title: 3CX desktop app trojan
examples.subject: New version available
examples.body:
3CX VoIP software (600,000+ companies).
Attacker ne build process compromise kiya.

Users ne update kiya - trojan install - attackers ko full access.

Crypto companies + BPOs primarily affected.

examples.title: npm package backdoor
examples.subject: Popular package update
examples.body:
Developer ne 'event-stream' jaisa popular npm package
ka control handover kiya.

Naya owner (attacker) ne malicious code inject kiya —
crypto wallet stealer.

Millions of apps install - wallets drained.

prevention: Critical systems ke liye staged rollout
real_case: 2020 — SolarWinds. 18,000+ customers affected, including US government agencies.

name: Calendar Phishing
short: Calendar invite me phishing link.
definition: Calendar apps auto-accept invites. Hacker ek calendar invite bhejta hai jisme phishing link hota hai. Aap calendar kholte ho, meeting dekhte ho, link click karte ho - phishing.
how_it_works: Victim calendar me reminder dekhta hai

examples.title: Fake payroll meeting
examples.subject: Invitation: Salary Revision Discussion
examples.body:
Calendar me auto-add: 'Salary Revision Meeting'
Tomorrow 10 AM
Description: View your new salary structure: [link]

Aap excited hote ho, link click karte ho.
Login page khulta hai (fake HR portal).

Credentials - hacker.

examples.title: Calendar invite with PDF
examples.subject: Invitation: Project Review
examples.body:
Meeting invite: 'Project Review — Q4'.
Attachment: 'agenda.pdf.exe' (double extension)
Ya description me: Download agenda: [link]

Aap download karte ho - malware.

examples.title: Zoom meeting invite
examples.subject: Invitation: Team Standup
examples.body:
Meeting: 'Daily Standup'
Zoom link: https://zoom-meetings-2026.tk/join

Aap link click karte ho - fake Zoom page - 'Sign in with Google'
- Google OAuth consent - account compromised.

prevention: Links in calendar manually verify karo
Meeting ke liye org se confirm karo
real_case: 2023 — Calendar phishing surge. Google ne auto-add default off kiya after user complaints.

name: Voicemail Phishing
short: Fake voicemail notification me malware.
definition: Aapko email aata hai: 'Aapke liye voicemail hai'. Attach me .wav / .mp3 file hoti hai — actually malware ya link. Ya transcribe kiya hua message hota hai jisme phishing link.
how_it_works: Victim download karta hai ya link click

examples.title: Fake business voicemail
examples.subject: New Voicemail from +1-XXX-XXX-XXXX (2:45)
examples.body:
You have a new voicemail.

From: +1-XXX-XXX-XXXX
Length: 2:45
Received: today 10:23 AM

[ Listen ] (downloads malware.wav.exe)
[ Transcribe ] (opens phishing page)

- Voicemail System

examples.title: Microsoft Teams voicemail
examples.subject: Missed call from Vikram Mehta
examples.body:
You missed a call from Vikram Mehta.

Voicemail duration: 0:45

Transcript:
Hi Rahul, quick question — need your Microsoft 365 credentials
to fix a login issue. Please share in reply or click here
to reset: [https://m365-reset.tk]

- Teams

examples.title: HR voicemail with urgent
examples.subject: Urgent voicemail from HR Director
examples.body:
HR Director ne voicemail chhoda:

Rahul, this is urgent. Please send your bank details for
salary correction. Deadline 2 PM today.

[Attachment: vm_2026.wav] (malware)

- HR

prevention: Transcript me link click mat karo
real_case: 2019 — Voicemail phishing campaigns targeting Office 365 users. Microsoft ne alerts issue kiye.

name: SMS Sender ID Spoofing
short: SMS me sender 'HDFC' dikhta hai — actually hacker hai.
definition: India me SMS sender ID (jaise 'HDFC', 'SBIINB') spoof karna easy hai. Hacker same sender ID use karta hai. Aapko asli bank ka SMS jaisa lagta hai — par actually fake hai.
how_it_works: Hacker SMS gateway use karta hai
Message asli bank jaisa likhta hai
Victim same thread me dekhta hai - trust karta hai

examples.title: Fake HDFC credit card alert
examples.subject: SMS
examples.body:
HDFC Bank: Rs.45,000 spent on your credit card XX1234
at AMAZON on 10-10-2026.

If not you, report immediately:
http://hdfc-card-alert.tk/report

- HDFCBK

[Message asli thread me dikhta hai — kyunki sender ID same hai]

examples.title: Fake UPI debit notification
examples.subject: SMS
examples.body:
SBI: Rs.15,000 debited from A/c XX7890 via UPI
to rahul@ybl on 10-10-2026.

If not you, click here to reverse:
http://sbi-upi-reverse.tk

- SBI
red_flags: Reverse link — banks never do this

examples.title: Fake ITR refund
examples.subject: SMS
examples.body:
Income Tax Dept: Aapka ITR refund Rs.8,450
approve hua hai. Bank details confirm karo:
http://itrefund-portal.tk/verify

Jaldi karo — 24 hours me.

- ITDEPT
red_flags: IT Dept SMS me link nahi bhejta

prevention: SMS links pe click mat karo
Bank app me transaction check karo
SMS sender ID pe trust mat karo
real_case: 2023-2024 — India me SMS sender ID spoofing wave. TRAI ne regulations tighten kiye.

name: Reels / Short Video Phishing
short: Instagram/YouTube Reels me phishing link.
definition: Short video platforms me description/bio me phishing link. Video: 'Free Netflix', 'Free iPhone', 'Earn Rs.5000/day'. Link bio me hota hai — victim click karta hai.

examples.title: Free Netflix Premium
examples.subject: Free Netflix trick
examples.body:
Reel: Netflix Premium FREE me kaise lein — trick!
15 second video with fake screen recording.

Bio link: http://netflix-free-2026.tk/claim

Click karo - Enter your Netflix email + password to activate

Credentials - hacker.

examples.title: Work from home job
examples.subject: Earn Rs.5000/day
examples.body:
Short: Ghar baithe Rs.5000/day kamao — no investment

Description link: http://work-from-home-2026.tk/apply

Click - form: Aadhaar, PAN, bank details, photo.

Data chori. Ya 'registration fee Rs.500' maangta hai.

examples.title: Free iPhone giveaway
examples.subject: iPhone 16 giveaway
examples.body:
Video: iPhone 16 free — just follow + comment!

DM me: Congratulations! Claim karne ke liye:
1. Follow this link
2. Complete 3 offers (each $5)
3. Enter shipping address + card for delivery

Actually: card charged $15/mo subscription, iPhone never arrives.

real_case: 2023 — Instagram Reels phishing surge. Meta ne lakhon fake accounts ban kiye.

name: Crypto / Web3 Phishing
short: Crypto wallet drain karna.
definition: Crypto irreversible hoti hai. Hacker fake crypto sites, wallet connect requests, ya NFT drops se wallet drain karta hai. Ek click me pura wallet khali.
how_it_works: Fake crypto exchange / NFT site banao

examples.title: Fake MetaMask upgrade
examples.subject: Critical security update required
examples.body:
Your MetaMask wallet needs urgent security update.

Click here: https://metamask-upgrade.tk/connect

[Connect Wallet] - Sign to verify

Sign karte hi — malicious contract approval
- Wallet drained ($50k+ gone in seconds)

examples.title: Free NFT mint
examples.subject: Free BAYC NFT mint
examples.body:
Twitter: Free BAYC NFT mint — limited to 500!

Link: http://boredape-free.tk/mint

[Connect Wallet]
Approve transaction to mint

Actually — transaction 'approve all' hai.
Wallet ka USDT, ETH, NFT sab drain.

examples.title: Fake job crypto payment
examples.subject: Salary in USDT - setup required
examples.body:
Congratulations! Salary USDT me milegi.

Setup ke liye:
1. Wallet address bhejo
2. Fund 0.1 ETH for gas (refundable)
3. Share seed phrase for verification

[Seed phrase share karte ho - wallet drained]

prevention: Seed phrase kabhi kisi ko mat do
real_case: 2022-2024 — Crypto phishing $1B+/year. Fake airdrops, wallet drainer kits ($500 me available).

name: MFA Fatigue / Push Bombing
short: Baar-baar 2FA push bhejo — victim accept kar dega.
definition: Hacker victim ka password le chuka hota hai. Ab wo baar-baar 2FA push notification bhejta hai (raat 2 baje bhi). Victim bored/annoyed hoke 'Approve' daba deta hai.
how_it_works: Attacker bar-bar login try karta hai
Victim ke phone pe 2FA push aata hai
Victim galti se approve kar deta hai

examples.title: Uber MFA fatigue attack
examples.subject: MFA prompt flood
examples.body:
Victim ke phone pe 50+ 2FA push notifications.

Raat 2 baje bhi.

Victim ne galti se 'Approve' kar diya.

Attacker andar ghus gaya.

Uber ne admit kiya — 2022.

examples.title: Cisco VPN MFA fatigue
examples.subject: MFA flood
examples.body:
Attacker ne victim ka password liya.
Cisco VPN pe login karta raha.
Victim ke phone pe 2FA aata raha.

Attacker ne victim ko call kiya — IT se bol raha hoon, please approve MFA.

Victim approve kar diya.

examples.title: Microsoft 365 MFA bomb
examples.subject: MFA notification flood
examples.body:
Attacker pehle password steal karta hai.
Phir 100+ MFA push bhejta hai.

Victim tired hoke approve kar deta hai.

Attacker email + files access.

prevention: Password change karo agar MFA flood aaye
real_case: 2022 — Uber + Cisco MFA fatigue attacks. Both companies confirmed data breach.
